validity.recommendation: Keep as a real, in-construction GASCO feeder line; note it is a governorate feeder network (Beni Suef->New Fayoum + Atsa + old-Fayoum reinforcement), not a single point-to-point trunk.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed by multiple independent Egyptian sources. GASCO's own 2023 year report (via elmostqpalelyuom.com/28363 and masrawy 2024-03-04) names 'مشروع خطوط تغذية الفيوم الجديدة ومدينة أطسا وتدعيم الفيوم القديمة بإجمالى أطوال 40 كم' (feeder-line project for New Fayoum + Atsa city + reinforcing old Fayoum, total 40 km). Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum approval reported by almasdar.com/165222 (2025-12-28): three natural-gas lines of 24-in and 16-in diameter, total 40.5 km, 70 bar operating pressure, under the presidential Hayah Karima initiative, incl. a ~19 km 24-in Beni Suef->New Fayoum main line with 3 blow-off valve chambers. Independent origins (GASCO annual report vs Ministry approval decision vs dostor coverage) — high confidence real. SPEC: LengthKnown=40 km matches (GASCO 40 km / Ministry 40.5 km, two independent origins -> high). Diameter 16,24 in matches (Ministry approval lists 24-in and 16-in -> high). Fuel=Gas confirmed (natural-gas network). Capacity blank and not fillable — no source gives a throughput; the only quantitative figure is 70 bar operating pressure (a pressure, not a capacity) so Capacity left blank rather than fabricated. CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType=transmission is defensible — 70 bar / 24-in GASCO line tapping the national gas grid, so transmission-class rather than local distribution — but caveat that these are governorate FEEDER lines to supply cities/villages ('لتغذية مدن وقرى محافظة الفيوم'), i.e. a spur network off the national grid, not a long-haul trunk. DUPLICATE: none — no other Egypt-gas roster row is in Fayoum (P6685 Solaimaneyah->Giza is a separate GASCO Hayah-Karima feeder in Giza, different location). ENDPOINTS: 'New Fayoum City -> Fayoum' is roughly right but the documented main line runs Beni Suef->New Fayoum; StartLocation could be refined to Beni Suef.

validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'General Petroleum Co' to GASCO (Egyptian Natural Gas Co); current owner ref is an unrelated Western Desert reservoir article that never names Fayoum.
validity.researcher_notes: ATTRIBUTION concern on Owner. Sheet records Owner1='General Petroleum Co' (GPC) 100%, ref = egyptoil-gas.com 'The Western Desert, Egypt's giant petroleum reservoir'. That article is about upstream E&P in the Western Desert and does NOT name the Fayoum feeder pipeline — it is an orphan/mismatched ref, not support for GPC ownership. Every independent source that actually names this project attributes it to GASCO (المصرية للغازات الطبيعية) as the executing owner/operator of these national-grid feeder lines (GASCO 2023 report via elmostqpalelyuom.com/28363 and masrawy 2024-03-04). GPC (an upstream oil company) is not the operator of gas transmission feeders. Recommend Owner1 -> GASCO. High confidence.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status=construction confirmed and active as of the newest evidence (2025-12), postdating the sheet's 2025-08-11. Timeline: GASCO's 2023 year report (elmostqpalelyuom/28363, masrawy 2024-03-04) describes the 40 km Fayoum feeder lines as ongoing/under completion; elfagr 2025-03-11 reports the launch of the Fayoum gas-line project under Hayah Karima; Ministry of Petroleum approval reported 2025-12-28 (almasdar/165222) authorizing the three 24-/16-in lines (40.5 km, 70 bar) with an 18-month execution window; dostor coverage (4519815, and 5232757 'head of New Fayoum City discusses start of the gas-connection project') confirms local mobilization. CAVEAT: the Dec-2025 formal approval framing sits slightly awkwardly against GASCO's 2023 'under completion' language — likely phased (earlier feeder segments executed; Dec-2025 decision is the formal authorization for the full three-line scope). Either reading keeps it in active construction/execution, well inside the 2-year staleness window, so no dormancy downgrade. No evidence of operation/commissioning yet, so not 'operating'.

summary: P6686 New Fayoum real GASCO Hayah-Karima feeder (40 km, 16/24-in, 70 bar); length/diameter/status(construction) confirmed high; ATTRIBUTION concern (Owner should be GASCO not General Petroleum Co); Location ref filled; Capacity unresolved (no source).
